        UNDER THE SURFACE

        Count the uncommon.

        Props counts layers across all 31,118 eligible unsigs. Values compares the ordered distribution, rotation and multiplier triples among unsigs with the same layer count. Colors separately compares the ordered Red/Green/Blue sequence within that count.

        Each column shows matching count, group size, collection share and its complement. Smaller shares mean rarer configurations. Layer order is significant. The ranking defaults to Values within property count; it is not a percentile rank.

        SHAREmatches ÷ comparison group × 100

        Total rarity remains the complement of actual overall matches for checked facets. Checking all three identifies every eligible unsig uniquely in this snapshot: all then tie at 1 of 31,118. This does not provide a useful most-to-least ordering. The list ranks the measure you choose separately.

        Data, geometry decisions & preview notes +

        Geometry code is retained as a reference. Pass two scores ordered parameters; geometry and named forms are not used in these scores. All 84 members of 3F-075 stay in one group, even when their detailed boundary patterns differ.

        Five project assignments differ from the published reference: #19656, #19686 and #21565 use 3F-108; #29883 and #30287 use 3F-094. These decisions are supported by original-page review and structural comparison. Reference codes are preserved and shown on affected results; these are project decisions, not official taxonomy revisions.

        Color clusters are retained in the source data but no longer scored. Their reference is published unsig.info memberships ↗. Geometry definitions and memberships were checked against unsig.info's geometry catalog ↗. Rarity is calculated from this site's reviewed snapshot, not marketplace prices or generation probabilities.

        Previews adapt the creator's rendering notebook ↗, with explicit modular arithmetic. They are parameter reconstructions, not certified archival image copies. See renderer license.

        Dataset snapshot: October 23, 2026 · 31,118 eligible items · 172 geometry codes · 132 color clusters. #00000 is excluded throughout.
